gloss: the brook where Eliajah was hidden
definition: כְּרִית proper name the brook where Eliajah was hidden 1Kgs 17:3 ; 1Kgs 17:5 , identify. dubious; accusative Rob BR ii. P. 288 wady el-Kelt , near Jericho; accusative Buhl Handw 12 Wady `Ajlun , east of Jordan, yet see Buhl G. 121 .
